name: punchboard
description: Turn any tablet or phone into a macro pad for your computer, with deep OBS support for streaming.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.app:dev: npm run build && npm run build:server && tauri dev
scripts.fixtures: node tests/fixtures/make-model.ts && node tests/fixtures/make-base.ts && node tests/fixtures/make-input.ts && node tests/fixtures/make-auth.ts
scripts.lint:rust: cd server && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check && cd ../src-tauri && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
